integrity: The proof composes Beyarslan--Kowalski Theorem 1.2 with their Corollary 6.2 and the standard fact that same-language extensions of a model-complete theory remain model-complete. The recent primary full text was inspected at both source statements; no computation is used.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns consistent same-language first-order extensions of ACFA and nonexistence of a model companion for a second commuting automorphism. It does not cover arbitrary expansions by new structure, and it does not classify non-elementary classes of existentially closed expansions.
title: No first-order strengthening of ACFA restores a generic commuting automorphism
